name: The Shave Parlor
summary: A website rebuild for a Cape Coral barbershop, with every page leading into the shop's Squire booking.
challenge: The shop's first site was a single-page React app. It needed a rebuild that keeps the look, gives services, barbers and the visit their own pages, and sends every booking to the Squire scheduler the shop already uses.

decisions.title: Squire booking boundary
decisions.detail: Scheduling stays in Squire. The site's job is to get visitors there: service cards, barber profiles, the header and a mobile call to action all lead to the same booking page.

decisions.title: Typed content
decisions.detail: Services, prices, barbers, reviews and visit details live in typed TypeScript data files, so the shop's details can change without touching layout code.

decisions.title: Real pages
decisions.detail: Experience, services, barbers and visit each have their own route and page metadata, replacing one long scrolling page.

detail: The rebuild moves the site to the Next.js App Router. It is still in progress: final corrections and delivery checks are pending, and the screens below come from the rebuild's review deployment.
role: Solo build: I engineered, built and set up this project.
